description: This file defines API routes for managing contracts within a FastAPI backend. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving details, insights, and uploading PDF contracts with text extraction and AI analysis integration.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a contract persisted in the database.

classes.name: Deadline
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a deadline related to a contract.

methods.name: Optional[str] auth_user(token: Optional[str])
methods.description: Validates a JWT token and returns the user ID if valid.

methods.name: list_contracts( authorization: Optional[str] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists all contracts owned by the authenticated user or returns an empty list if unauthorized.

methods.name: get_contract_detail( contract_id: str = Path(..., description="Contract identifier"), authorization: Optional[str] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific contract, ensuring it belongs to the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_contract_insights( contract_id: str, authorization: Optional[str] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves stored insights for a specific contract.

methods.name: upload_and_analyze_contract( file: UploadFile = File(...), authorization: Optional[str] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles uploading of a PDF contract, extracts text, analyzes it including AI integration, stores the file and results, and creates database entries.
